//: Typecheck config for the scripts tree (#1504).
The app's tsconfig excludes `scripts` and `worker`, so `pnpm build` and
`npx tsc --noEmit` never look at ~280 node test suites or the production
canary scripts that run against live prod every 30 minutes. An undefined
identifier in one of them reported CLEAN and only surfaced when the script
was actually run, and inside a test fake it made a safety-critical guard
There are ~100 errors in the tree, mostly nullable and shape mismatches in
test fakes, so this config is NOT wired into `tsc --noEmit` wholesale.
`scripts/test-scripts-typecheck.ts` runs it and fails on the two classes
that break at RUNTIME (an undefined name, an unresolved import), which is
the class that actually ships broken. Tighten by fixing errors and adding
their codes to that guard's list.
`worker/` is deliberately not included: its two errors need
@cloudflare/workers-types, which is not a dependency here.
